summary: This April 2026 education interview is already public source support for Education As A Soul Game and Meritocracy Converts Wounds Into Credentials: creativity becomes scientific rebellion against authority-school, while best-student fragility exposes the credential game from inside its winners.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: creativity means using the scientific process to solve problems, not obeying the teacher, memorizing outputs, or fearing mistakes.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Education page already carries this source as the stable anchor for creativity as evidence, experiment, mistake, imagination, speech, and precise feedback against authority-school.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the practical classroom layer of Education, where Jiang defines creativity as scientific problem-solving, diagnoses Chinese classrooms as anti-creative authority training, and shows reform requiring proof in the room, parent/teacher persuasion, safety plus exact feedback, wellbeing, meta-learning, and teacher redundancy.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Education owns this when the active mechanism is school formation: authority, trust, exams, parent fear, teacher status, mistake tolerance, and the student's relation to evidence. Living School owns later institution-building only when the source turns toward the global classroom, subscriber community, or building a school outside the existing system.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the best-student fragility layer, where winners of the test game become addicted to quick answers, memorization, praise, and standardized certainty, then struggle with evidence-based reasoning, empathy, perspective, and open-ended questions.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: The meritocracy child owns the credential-winner failure mode. The Education parent keeps only the gateway version because the broader page must stay a map of school formation rather than a second full meritocracy essay.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Do not extend Living School from this source now. The interview supplies classroom philosophy and teacher practice, but it does not yet foreground the distributed public classroom, subscriber community, school-site problem, or post-platform institutional form that Living School now owns.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Living School can cite this later as prehistory for teacher redundancy and education as liberation, but the active mechanism in the April 5 interview remains classroom formation inside the Education/Meritocracy cluster.

new_lens_seeds.title: Scientific Creativity As School Rebellion
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Creativity becomes reusable when students learn to treat truth as something discovered through evidence, experiment, mistake, feedback, and revision rather than inherited from teacher authority or secured by test certainty.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism can compare Galileo/science, Chinese classroom authority, Great Books pedagogy, meta-learning, and later democratic creativity sources, but it is already carried by Education's stable lens point and does not need a standalone page now.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a named comparison seed only. Creating a separate Creativity page from this source would duplicate the Education anchor and blur the school-formation boundary.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2026-04-05, this source sits after the test-score/institutional-trust and meritocracy-child sources but before the June 2026 Exit Plan source. It supplies the mature classroom bridge: Jiang keeps the anti-authority education claim concrete through books, scenes, evidence, feedback, wellbeing, and the teacher's goal of becoming redundant.

The source gives a late autobiographical correction to meritocracy: Jiang says he benefited from meritocracy but became skeptical of it, and he now wants elite education made available to every student rather than only the best students.

next_actions.action: No public Education or Meritocracy append is needed now; both pages already carry the source with inline evidence and Education has a stable lens point for the strongest mechanism.

Do not create standalone Creativity, Anti-Creative Classroom, Teacher Redundancy, Meta-Learning, Best Student Fragility, Chinese Teacher Culture, Judy Blume, or Elite Education For Everyone pages from this source alone.

If synthesis follows, prefer a replacement/compression pass on the Education parent that compares this April 5 classroom mechanism with the June 13 Exit Plan democratized-creativity source, while keeping Living School focused on public institution-building rather than ordinary classroom method.
